_source: Mcu.xdm (S32K344 RTD 7.0.1) C:/NXP/S32DS.3.6.7/S32DS/software/PlatformSDK_S32K3/RTD/Mcu_TS_T40D34M70I1R0/config/Mcu.xdm + reference_configs/S32K344/Mcu.xdm + example_Dio.mex verified 160 MHz working config. This file is a committed reference document pinned against apply.py by test_clock_json_matches_apply_code_literals; it is NOT loaded at runtime.

_coverage._note: Honest map of the Mcu editable surface this CLI exposes today vs. the Mcu.xdm items NOT yet configurable through the `mcu set` surface. Forward (Spec-first) development tracks the deferred surface explicitly so callers know the boundary; full-surface expansion of every Mcu.xdm field is a separate, larger effort (issues #37/#38). The deferred fields below DO exist in Mcu.xdm and are currently left at fixture defaults -- they are not absent, just not user-tunable yet.

clock_tree_recipe: 160/80/40 MHz fixed recipe (PLL 480MHz VCO -> PHI0/PHI1 -> CGM Mux0 dividers)
McuPll_Configuration (Odiv0_En/Odiv1_En enable; PLL divider params RDIV/MFI/ODIV2/Odiv0_Div/Odiv1_Div are InfoSetting -- ConfigTools derives them from clock_settings + quick_selection)
clock_reference_points: McuClockReferencePoint array merge (preserve existing + add selectable clocks)
20 fixture-safe S32K344 clock reference point names (see all_selectable_clocks below; 10 deferred clocks noted in deferred_clocks)

not_yet_exposed._note: Each item is an Mcu.xdm editable field currently fixed at a fixture default or not yet wired through the CLI intent surface. Exposing any of these is future scope.
clock_settings_top_level: CORE_MFD.scale, PLL_PREDIV.scale, PHI0.scale, PHI1.scale, POSTDIV.scale (left at fixture defaults; not user-tunable)
MC_CGM_MUX_0_DIV0.scale (CORE_CLK divisor; left at fixture default scale=1)
MC_CGM_MUX_0_DIV7.divider_not_in_fixture (CM7_CORE_CLK; Div7 absent from Uart_Example.mex; CM7_CORE_CLK deferred — see deferred_clocks)
CORE_PLLODIV_2_DE, CORE_PLLODIV_3_DE (additional PLL output dividers; not configured)
clock_output values (ConfigTools computes these; CLI does not write them)
Multiple McuClockSettingConfig instances (CLI edits only _0; reference config has 2)
oscillator_config: McuFXOSC: McuFxoscPowerDownCtr, McuFxoscBypass, McuFxoscMainComparator, McuFxoscCounter, McuFxoscOverdriveProtection, McuFxoscALCEnable
McuSXOSC: McuSxoscUnderMcuControl, McuSxoscCounter, McuSxoscPowerDownCtr, all SXOSC parameters
cgm_muxes: McuCgm0ClockMux1 through McuCgm0ClockMux20 (only Mux0 is configured today)

McuCgm0ClockMux12 through McuCgm0ClockMux20 are absent from the Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture; their 9 corresponding clocks (EMAC_TX_RMII_CLK, STM2_CLK, USDHC_PER_CLK, LFAST_REF_CLK, SWG_CLK, GMAC1_RMII_CLK, STM3_CLK, AES_CLK, FLEXCAN_PE_CLK8_11) are deferred (see deferred_clocks above)
McuCgm0ClockMux0 Div7 (CM7_CORE_CLK) absent from fixture; CM7_CORE_CLK deferred (see deferred_clocks above)
pll: McuPll_1 (AUX PLL; visible only on multi-PLL devices)
PLL FM/FD parameters: McuPllFmSscgbyp, McuPllFmSpreadctl, McuPllFmStepSize, McuPllFmStepNo, McuPllFdFmod, McuPllFdMdp, McuPllFdMfn, McuPllFdSdmen, McuPllFdSdm2, McuPllFdSdm3
clock_monitoring: McuClkMonitor list (monitoring thresholds, deviation, latency per clock)
power_modes: McuPeripheral list (per-peripheral clock enable + mode entry slot)
power_control: McuPowerControl/McuPMC_AE_Config (LIN PHY supply, voltage level select)
ram: McuRamSectorSettingConf list (base address, size, default value)
general_config: McuControlledClocksConfiguration: McuFxoscUnderMcuControl, McuSxoscUnderMcuControl, McuFircUnderMcuControl, McuSircUnderMcuControl, McuPll1UnderMcuControl
dependencies: External crystal frequency inputs (McuCrystalFrequencyHz, McuSlowCrystalFrequencyHz, etc.)

enum_domains._source: Mcu.xdm McuClockFrequencySelect INVALID rules (lines 14008-14152) + reference_configs/S32K344/Mcu.xdm; each clock maps to its CGM0 divider source.

McuClockFrequencySelect._note: Fixture-safe subset for S32K344 from Mcu.xdm INVALID constraints (lines 14008-14152). The full Mcu.xdm RANGE ecu:list('MCU.ClockReferencePoints.List') resolves to ~48+ literals at tool runtime (including GMAC variants, QSPI aliases, RTC_CLK, SCS_CLK, CUSTOM, etc.). This asset documents the 20 CGM0-derivable + source clocks whose mux dividers exist in the Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture; 10 additional clocks with absent mux structs (Mux12-20 + Mux0 Div7) are recorded in deferred_clocks. The all_selectable_clocks list below is the 20-clocks subset the CLI inserts as McuClockReferencePoint entries.

McuClkMux0_Source._note: McuClkMux0_Source options; resolved from ecu:MCU.CGM0.ClockMux0.List at tool runtime. Verified from S32K344 reference config.

McuPllClockSelection._note: McuPll_0 PLL source select; resolved from ecu:MCU.PLL0.PllClockSelectionSupport at tool runtime.

McuPowerMode._note: Power modes for McuModeSettingConf. Source: Mcu.xdm ENUMERATION.

McuFircDivSel._note: FIRC divider select. Source: Mcu.xdm ENUMERATION.

McuClockMonitorDeviation._note: Clock monitor deviation tolerance. Partial list from Mcu.xdm HTML table.

constraints._source: Mcu.xdm INVALID rules extracted from the descriptor. Each rule cites the Mcu.xdm source. Enforced at the S32DS vendor gate; listed here for traceability.

mcu_no_pll_vs_pll_control._source: Mcu.xdm INVALID rule (~line 4104-4113): McuNoPll='true' AND McuPLLUnderMcuControl='true' -> SEVERE 'PLL cannot be under MCU control if McuNoPll is enabled'
mcu_no_pll_vs_pll_control.fix: apply_mcu_set sets McuNoPll=false when configuring PLL (GAP 1)

pll_under_mcu_control_requires_controlle._source: Mcu.xdm INVALID rule: McuPLLUnderMcuControl='true' but McuControlledClocksConfiguration/McuPll0UnderMcuControl='false' -> SEVERE
pll_under_mcu_control_requires_controlle.fix: apply_mcu_set sets McuPll0UnderMcuControl=true when configuring PLL (GAP 2)

clock_ref_requires_divider_enabled._source: Mcu.xdm INVALID rules (lines 14008-14152): each McuClockFrequencySelect value requires its corresponding CGM0 divider to be enabled (e.g. CORE_CLK requires Div0_En=true, STM0_CLK requires Mux1 Div0_En=true)
clock_ref_requires_divider_enabled.note: The CLI inserts reference points with Name==McuClockFrequencySelect; the fixture must already have the corresponding dividers enabled. The CLI does not currently auto-enable dividers.

fxosc_frequency_range.note: The 160/80/40 recipe assumes FXOSC=16 MHz (S32K344 reference config default). Other crystal values require different PLL parameters.

hse_clk_max_120mhz._source: Mcu.xdm INVALID: HSE_CLK (Mux0 Div3 output) frequency must be <= 120 MHz
hse_clk_max_120mhz.fix: MC_CGM_MUX_0_DIV3.scale=2 divides 160 MHz CORE -> 80 MHz HSE_CLK, satisfying the constraint

pll_phi0_div1_scale_1._source: S32K344 reference config: MC_CGM_MUX_0_DIV0.scale must be 1 (CORE_CLK undivided from Mux0 source)
pll_phi0_div1_scale_1.note: DIV0.scale is left at fixture default (1); not changed by the CLI

clock_settings_changes.source_ref: Mcu.xdm (PLLunderMcuControl must be Enabled when PLL is under MCU control)

McuGeneralConfiguration._source_ref: Mcu.xdm INVALID: McuNoPll=true AND McuPLLUnderMcuControl=true -> SEVERE (GAP 1 fix)

McuControlledClocksConfiguration._source_ref: Mcu.xdm INVALID: McuPLLUnderMcuControl=true but McuPll0UnderMcuControl=false -> SEVERE (GAP 2 fix)

recipes._note: McuPllDvRdiv/McuPllDvMfi/McuPllDvOdiv2/McuPllOdiv0_Div/McuPllOdiv1_Div are InfoSetting per Mcu.xdm component definition -- ConfigTools derives them from clock_settings (CORE_MFD.scale=120, PLL_PREDIV.scale=2, PHI0.scale=3, POSTDIV.scale=2) when quick_selection="Default" is preserved on McuPll_Parameter. These fields are NOT written by the CLI; writing them as StoragePeriphsScalarSetting causes [SDK/DATA] SEVERE type-mismatch and [TOOL] SEVERE '该取值值不可用'. Grounded in S32DS 3.6.7 validation on 2026-06-30.

deferred_clocks._note: 10 clocks from the full Mcu.xdm enum domain whose CGM mux dividers are absent from the Uart_Example_S32K344 fixture. These cannot currently be inserted as McuClockReferencePoint entries.
